verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; intake coverage is the immediate priority.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 18 leads at an average cost of $137.58 per lead, but the final week saw lead volume fall 60% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat — a clear sign of reduced efficiency, not a budget cut. Two consecutive days of zero Google Ads spend (July 29–30) point to a budget exhaustion or brief campaign pause mid-week, which we are auditing and correcting now. On the intake side, 104 opportunities were opened in your CRM this period with zero converted to booked appointments, which traces to a coverage gap following a staffing change on July 7th — ads bringing leads in means little if those leads aren't being followed up. Meta is currently delivering leads at roughly $35 each versus $132 on Google Ads, so budget weight is being reviewed in Meta's favor while the Google campaign is stabilized. Next period, expect tightened Google pacing and a clearer picture of booked jobs as intake coverage improves.
